description: Logs in, finds a member by ID, and opens a new sub-account for them — the one genuinely irreversible flow in this app. Live-verified 2026-09-24 (evidence/app-profile-verification/open-member-sub-account-flow.aria.yaml): the wizard is three pages (new -> review -> created), and nothing is created until the final 'Confirm and Open Account' click on the review page — the earlier 'Open Sub-Account' button is just navigation to the form, not the irreversible action itself.

memberId.description: The member ID to open a sub-account for.

accountType.description: One of the account type options exactly as rendered: "Savings Club", "Money Market", or "Certificate of Deposit".

initialDeposit.description: The initial deposit amount, as a plain number (e.g. "500") — the app renders it back formatted as currency on the review and created pages.

target.name: Username
target.rationale: The Username field has a stable accessible name via its associated <label>.

target.name: Password
target.rationale: The Password field has a stable accessible name via its associated <label>.

target.name: Log In
target.rationale: The only submit control on the login form.

target.name: Member ID
target.rationale: The search field's accessible name for the default tenant.

target.name: Search
target.rationale: The search form's submit control for the default tenant.

target.name: Open Sub-Account
target.rationale: The only control that starts the sub-account wizard from the member detail page. Purely navigational — verified live (open-member-sub-account-flow.aria.yaml) to have no side effect of its own, which is why it's classified safe rather than irreversible.

target.name: Account Type
target.rationale: The wizard's only combobox; its accessible name matches the row header rendered beside it.

target.name: Initial Deposit
target.rationale: The wizard's only free-text amount field.

target.name: I agree to the terms and conditions
target.rationale: The wizard's only checkbox; starts unchecked on a fresh form, so a single click always checks it.

target.name: Continue
target.rationale: Advances from the form to the review page. Still no side effect — verified live: the review page only restates what was entered, nothing is created yet.

target.name: Confirm and Open Account
target.rationale: The genuine point of no return — this is the click that actually creates the sub-account, and the same control declared in the app profile's irreversibleControls. Without --allow-irreversible (and no --interactive handoff), replay stops here rather than attempting it.
